Good food & equally good service
Jan 2025 • Friends
I have been eating breakfast here for the past 4 days and they have a very nice selection of western and Asian breakfast options. Something for literally everyone. 
Even when completely full of guests, the staff are very professional delivering good service. Today, I had lunch here with a friend visiting from Can Tho and this is the main focus of this review.

My friend had left Can Tho just before midday so we settled for a very late lunch and understandably were the only ones in the restaurant. I appreciated that the staff totally accommodated us. The service was very warm and friendly. 

To keep things simple, we ordered two main dishes and a salad: one noodle seafood dish, the other a pasta ragu bolognese. The food was pretty delicious. We were left alone to enjoy a very relaxed and unhurried lunch giving us plenty of time to catch up. 

A big thanks of gratitude to the dinning room & kitchen staff for taking care of us with no prior notice of our unusually late lunch. It’s truly appreciated it.

Our 18th wedding anniversary dinner with friends
Dec 2018 • Family
My husband booked a table a month in advance to celebrate our wedding anniversary. 

He made reservations for 10 (we are visiting Vietnam with our friends). My husband went to the restaurant 1 day in advance to make a deposit and to tell them it was our anniversary. 

The restaurant is beautiful and I loved the open kitchen. We were all seated promptly. 

Then the server asked for our orders. Just like when you walk up to the McDonalds counter. We were taken by surprise and decided to just go with it. After we placed our order, we thought she would take our drink orders. She didn’t, she just left. We had to raise our hands to get her attention. Finally got her back to the table, the kids placed their drink orders and I ordered a glass of champagne. Without taking the order of the four other adults at our table, she took off. I had to throw my hands in the air and wave her down again. 

Our orders came and the food is delicious. Everyone loved their food. 

Now for the dessert and to toast our anniversary. Our experience was similar to our drink order ordeal. Half got desserts and others had to wait (even though it was the same order as the others). 

Here’s why I feel they turned a celebration into a very frustrating experience. When you go to these types of restaurant, you go for the overall experience. We have travelled the world and part of our love of travel is tied in with going to great restaurants. Square missed the mark. 

Paying $700 for dinner with the same feeling I get walking up to a food counter is just not worth it. 

Disappointed...save your money.
